title: 🏠 Rooms & Floors
description: Учим названия комнат и порядковые числительные (1st-20th) с юмором. Уровень A0. 6 дней.

grammar.title: Types of Rooms
grammar.rule:
В каждом доме есть разные комнаты. Вот основные:

🏠 living room — гостиная (место для отдыха, телевизор, диван)
🍳 kitchen — кухня (место, где готовят еду)
🛏️ bedroom — спальня (место для сна)
🛁 bathroom — ванная (место, где принимают душ)
🍽️ dining room — столовая (место для обеда)
📚 study — кабинет (место для учёбы или работы)
🚗 garage — гараж (место для машины)
🧺 laundry room — прачечная (место для стирки)

🎯 Вопрос: What room is this? — Что это за комната?
examples: Leo: 'I sleep in my bedroom. Sometimes I also do homework there... but mostly sleep.' 🛏️😴
Mia: 'Mum is in the kitchen. She's making pizza. The best room ever!' 🍕
Sam: 'The living room has a huge TV. That's where I watch YouTube.' 📺
grammar.keywords: living room, kitchen, bedroom, bathroom, dining room, study, garage

vocabulary.example: We watch TV in the living room.
Mum is cooking in the kitchen.
My bedroom is my favourite place.
I take a shower in the bathroom.
We eat dinner in the dining room.
Dad works in his study.

exercises.question: Where do you sleep? 🛏️
Where does mum cook dinner? 🍳
I watch TV in the ___ room. (live / living)
We eat dinner in the ___ room. (dine / dining)
You take a shower in the kitchen.
exercises.explanation: You take a shower in the bathroom, not in the kitchen! 🚿

days.title: Day 2: More Rooms and Places
days.description: Учим дополнительные комнаты и места в доме

grammar.title: More Rooms
grammar.rule:
Продолжаем изучать комнаты и места в доме:

🚗 garage — гараж
🧺 laundry room — прачечная
🎮 game room — игровая комната
🏊 swimming pool — бассейн
🌳 garden — сад
🪑 attic — чердак
地下室 basement — подвал

🎯 Вопрос: Where is the car? — Где машина?
🎯 Ответ: The car is in the garage.
examples: Sam: 'My dream house has a game room with five consoles!' 🎮
Mia: 'We have a swimming pool in the garden. In summer, it's amazing!' 🏊
Leo: 'Our attic is full of old toys and scary spiders.' 🕷️😱
grammar.keywords: garage, laundry room, game room, swimming pool, garden, attic, basement

vocabulary.example: The car is in the garage.
Mum does laundry in the laundry room.
The game room has a PlayStation and Xbox.
vocabulary.context_example: В игровой комнате есть PlayStation и Xbox.

vocabulary.example: We swim in the swimming pool in summer.
Flowers grow in the garden.
Old toys are in the attic.

exercises.question: Where do you park the car? 🚗
Where do you swim in summer? 🏊
Old things are in the ___ . (attic / garage)
exercises.explanation: Attic — чердак, место для старых вещей 📦

exercises.question: Flowers grow in the ___ . (garden / garage)
A game room is for cooking.
exercises.explanation: A game room is for playing video games, not cooking! 🎮

days.title: Day 3: Ordinal Numbers 1st-10th
days.description: Учим порядковые числительные от первого до десятого

grammar.title: Ordinal Numbers 1st-10th
grammar.rule:
Порядковые числительные показывают порядок предметов (первый, второй, третий...).

1st — first 🥇
2nd — second 🥈
3rd — third 🥉
4th — fourth
5th — fifth
6th — sixth
7th — seventh
8th — eighth
9th — ninth
10th — tenth

🎯 Лайфхак: Запомни исключения — first, second, third, fifth, eighth, ninth! Остальные просто добавляют -th.
🎯 Вопрос: Which floor? — Какой этаж?
examples: Leo: 'I live on the first floor. My room is the first door on the left.' 🚪
Mia: 'My birthday is on the fifth of May!' 🎂
Sam: 'I was the second person to arrive at school. The first was the teacher!' 🏫
grammar.keywords: first, second, third, fourth, fifth, sixth, seventh, eighth, ninth, tenth

vocabulary.example: I was first in the race!
My birthday is on the second of June.
The third lesson is Maths.
I live on the fourth floor.
Friday is the fifth day of the week.

exercises.question: What is the ordinal number for 1? 🥇
What is the ordinal number for 3? 🥉
The ordinal number for 2 is 'twoth'.

days.title: Day 4: Ordinal Numbers 11th-20th
days.description: Учим порядковые числительные от одиннадцатого до двадцатого

grammar.title: Ordinal Numbers 11th-20th
grammar.rule:
Продолжаем изучать порядковые числительные:

11th — eleventh
12th — twelfth
13th — thirteenth
14th — fourteenth
15th — fifteenth
16th — sixteenth
17th — seventeenth
18th — eighteenth
19th — nineteenth
20th — twentieth

🎯 Лайфхак: С 13 по 19 просто добавляем -th к числу (four → fourteenth). Исключение — 12th (twelfth, не twelveth!) и 20th (twentieth, заменили y на ie).
examples: Leo: 'The eleventh of November is a holiday.' 📅
Mia: 'My grandma is eighty years old. She was born on the twentieth of March.' 👵
Sam: 'I have fifteen problems in maths. The twelfth is the hardest!' 🤯
grammar.keywords: eleventh, twelfth, thirteenth, fourteenth, fifteenth, sixteenth, seventeenth, eighteenth, nineteenth, twentieth

vocabulary.example: November is the eleventh month.
December is the twelfth month.
Friday the thirteenth is unlucky for some!
vocabulary.context_example: Пятница тринадцатое — несчастливый день для некоторых!

vocabulary.example: My birthday is on the fifteenth of May.
The twentieth century was from 1901 to 2000.
vocabulary.context_example: Двадцатый век был с 1901 по 2000 год.

exercises.question: What is the ordinal number for 12? 🔢
What is the ordinal number for 20? 🎂
The ordinal number for 11 is 'eleventh'.

days.title: Day 5: Practice — Rooms & Ordinals
days.description: Повторяем комнаты и порядковые числительные вместе

grammar.title: Revision: Rooms & Ordinal Numbers
grammar.rule:
Сегодня соединяем комнаты и порядковые числительные!

📌 Комнаты: living room, kitchen, bedroom, bathroom, dining room, study, garage, garden, attic
📌 Порядковые числительные: 1st-20th

🎯 Структура: 'The kitchen is on the first floor.'

examples: Leo: 'My bedroom is on the second floor. The first floor has the living room and kitchen.' 🏠
Mia: 'The bathroom is on the third floor. It's very tiny!' 🚿
Sam: 'The attic is on the top floor. It's scary up there!' 👻

exercises.question: Which room is on the first floor? 🥇
exercises.explanation: Usually, the living room is on the first floor! 🛋️

exercises.question: What is the ordinal number for 6? 🔢
The ___ (4th) of July is a holiday in the USA. 🎆
I sleep in the ___ . (living room / bedroom)
The car is in the ___ . (garage / garden)
I live on the twoth floor.
exercises.correct: I live on the second floor.

days.title: Day 6: Reading — The Mystery of the Third Floor
days.description: Читаем детективную историю о загадочной комнате

grammar.title: Reading: The Mystery of the Third Floor
grammar.rule: Сегодня читаем историю о семье, которая переехала в новый дом и обнаружила загадочную комнату...

exercises.question: How many floors does the house have? 🏠
exercises.explanation: The house has a first floor, second floor, and third floor.
exercises.readingText:
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🔍 THE MYSTERY OF THE THIRD FLOOR
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

📍 SCENE: The Johnson family moves into an old house. The house has three floors.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

MUM: 'The kitchen and living room are on the first floor.'

DAD: 'The children's bedrooms are on the second floor.'

LEO: 'What's on the third floor?'

DAD: 'Nothing. The third floor is just an empty attic.'

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

(That night, Leo hears strange noises from the third floor. Bump. Bump. Bump.)

LEO: (whispers to Mia) 'Do you hear that?'

MIA: 'It's probably just a mouse.' 🐭

LEO: 'A mouse that sounds like an elephant?'

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

(The next day, the children go upstairs to investigate.)

MIA: 'The first floor is fine. The second floor is fine.'

LEO: 'But the third floor... what is that room?'

🚪 DOOR: 'DO NOT ENTER' (written in red letters)

LEO: 'Mia, this is scary.'

MIA: 'Don't be a baby, Leo.' (opens the door)

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

(Inside the room, there is... A GUINEA PIG IN A TINY HOUSE! 🐹)

MIA: 'It's a guinea pig!'

LEO: 'That was the scary monster? A guinea pig?'

🐹 GUINEA PIG: 'Wheek wheek!'

LEO: (picks up the guinea pig) 'You scared me! But you're cute.'

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

(Leo and Mia take the guinea pig downstairs.)

MUM: 'Where did you find that?'

LEO: 'On the third floor. In a tiny house.'

MUM: 'Oh, that's Mr. Whiskers. The previous owner forgot him.'

LEO: 'So... can we keep him?'

MUM: 'Fine. But you clean his cage.'

LEO: (looks at guinea pig) 'Welcome to the family, Mr. Whiskers. Now you live on the first floor with us.' 🐹

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

(That night, no strange noises. Just happy wheeking from the kitchen.)

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
